note: GD.7 (FD.13). A qualified heritage base keeps its qualifier: it binds only the in-repo type at that path, never an app type sharing its last segment, and never the declaring class itself. rb holds two Base classes (top-level and Admin::Base); rb-unique holds one, so a name-only lookup of `ActiveRecord::Base` is unique there. Baseline HEAD ec4946df (installed leap wheel): Account INHERITS_FROM app::models::base::Base, Post INHERITS_FROM src::Models::Model, K INHERITS_FROM com::app::Base, Guard INHERITS_FROM src::Security, J INHERITS_FROM com::app::Repo, Ctl / Guard IMPORTS src::Security and the compat XEx self-loop all fire (8 forbid violations; User binds nothing on HEAD because rb holds two Base classes); Admin::Report -> Admin::Base, compat XEx -> the main XEx and Q -> the main XEx are missing (INHERITS_FROM 2/5).
